unit_of_classification: speaker turn with preceding dialogue context

conventions.target_label: The decision boundary tested by the sample.
conventions.expected_target_value: 1 means target label present on focal turn; 0 means absent.
conventions.target_turn_gold_labels: All deliberately instantiated ontology labels on the focal turn. An empty array means none of the four labels is intended.
conventions.ontology_alignment: For positives, records an inclusion criterion satisfied by the focal turn. For hard negatives, records the target-label exclusion criterion that keeps the focal turn outside that class.
